This question asks me to forecast which stock will have higher returns over a one-week period (Oct 11-18, 2026). Without real-time data or knowledge of events after my training cutoff, I must rely on general principles:

1. SCHW is a financial services/brokerage company; ADI is a semiconductor manufacturer
2. Over short 1-week periods, stock returns are largely unpredictable and driven by company-specific news, market sentiment, and broader market movements
3. Both are established, large-cap companies with different sector exposures
4. Semiconductor stocks (ADI) tend to be more volatile than financial services stocks (SCHW)
5. Without specific catalysts or information, short-term relative performance is essentially random

Given the unpredictability of 1-week stock performance and no clear reason to favor one over the other, this should be close to 50%. The slightly higher volatility of semiconductor stocks might give a marginal edge to either direction, but this is minimal over such a short timeframe.
